description: Get a consolidated sandbox behaviour summary for a file (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256), merged across every sandbox that analyzed it. Returns processes, files, registry, network activity, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, IDS alerts, and signature matches in a single view — far more useful than iterating individual behaviour reports.

hash.description: MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash of the file

name: get_file_behaviour_summary
